name: Spider-Man (Symbiote)

abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Tek tehlike özel saldırı sonrası 1,1sn'lik kaçış bonusu — kaçış-karşıtı yeteneği olmadan özel saldırılarına karşılık verme. Kaçtığında zırh kırar ve %4 can yeniler. Bonus kontrolü veya kaçışı kapatan şampiyonlar en iyi cevap.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.

abilitySections.title: Great Irresponsibility - Always Active
content: The Symbiote's hunger for power grants Spider-Man Immunity to Heal Block, Power Drain, and Power Burn effects.
All personal Buffs other than Regeneration and Evade are paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: We Are Spider-Man - Armor Breaks
content: The first hit of Spider-Man's Heavy Attack inflicts 4 [305.56] Armor Break Debuffs for 80 seconds. Max stacks: 4.
When Spider-Man Evades, he inflicts a [305.56] Armor Break Debuff for 80 seconds. Max stacks: 16.

abilitySections.title: Genetic Reflex
content: At the start of each fight, Spider-Man activates Genetic Reflex for 30 seconds, and reactivates it when it expires naturally.
Reactivating Genetic Reflex changes its icon to reflect the next Reflex Buff, cycling through them in the following order:
A 7.5% Energize Buff, a 15% Expertise Buff, and a 22.5% Vitality Buff. These Buffs last 30 seconds. Max stacks: 2 of each.
Spider-Man's third Light Attack grants him the currently selected Reflex Buff, refreshes all Reflex Buffs, and reactivates Genetic Reflex.

abilitySections.title: Spider-Sense - Evade
content: Finishing a Special Attack grants a Evade Buff for 1.1 seconds. As an Attacker, it starts paused until Spider-Man Evades.
While this Evade Buff is active, the Opponent is more aggressive. Personal Evades will not trigger while Blocking.
Evading Basic Attacks pauses the Evade Buff for 0.35 seconds, its first Evade inflicts 3 extra Armor Breaks.
Personal Evades have a 60% chance to grant a Regeneration Buff healing 4% of missing Health over 5 seconds. Max stacks: 5.
If the Evade Buff ends after triggering an Evade, it goes on a 15 second cooldown that expires 200% faster during Heavy Attack hits.

abilitySections.title: Symbiote-Sense - True Accuracy
content: Activating a Special Attack grants a True Accuracy Buff for 5 seconds, unaffected by Ability Accuracy modifications against Tech Champions.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Web of Shadows
content: On each hit, gain a +[79.22] Cruelty Buff for 30 seconds. Max stacks: 6.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Lash Out
content: On the first landed hit, gain a +[2,750] Precision Buff for 45 seconds, plus an additional Precision for each unique Reflex Buff. Max stacks: 4.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Ruthless Protector
content: Refresh 50% (rounded down) of the Armor Breaks Spider-Man inflicts when he Evades, and gain an indefinite +[2,287.8] Fury Buff. Max stacks: 2.
The first two times this Special Attack is used, the max stacks for the Armor Breaks Spider-Man inflicts when he Evades is increased by 4.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Back in Black
content: Personal Regeneration Buffs gain +[10 - 50]% base Ability Accuracy.
Personal True Accuracy Buff lasts +[5 - 10] seconds longer per level of the Special Attack that activated it.
